zh: 一百五十年前，人类启动全球生态修复工程，试图清除百余年工业积累的污染。
en: 150 years ago, humanity launched a global ecological restoration project to clear a century of industrial pollution.

zh: 人类将一批胚胎、种子与休眠者送上环绕地球的方舟，等待地面恢复。
en: Humanity sent embryos, seeds and sleepers up to an ark orbiting the Earth, to wait for the ground to recover.

zh: 八年前，按照方舟的计划，第一个孩子出生了。
en: Eight years ago, following the ark's plan, the first child was born.
You are responsible for raising her.

zh: 她出生那天，你为她取了名字：{girl}
en: On the day she was born, you gave her a name: {girl}
Ever since {girl} learned to talk, she has called you: {player}

zh: 工程失控。修复性状扩散至几乎所有植物，地表植被由此富集毒素，人类无法在地面长期生存。
en: The project went out of control. The restoration trait spread to almost every plant; surface vegetation began to concentrate toxins, and humans could no longer live on the ground for long.

zh: 致明日的你 / To You, Tomorrow
